content.content: 1. Necessity: the dependent needs the globals for deccy --help listing all verbs — without them, listing with no verb is motiveless. Fail if the edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: no element contradicts any prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: Listing is where the verb set meets the globals; the gate keeps the use sound without testing the verb set itself.
